name: Meter Petrol

accent.usage: Selection, focus and the primary reading. Use the light variant on light surfaces and the dark variant on dark surfaces.

icon.appearance: Use the light tile in both light and dark appearances.

raster_contrast_16px.method: Actual icon_16x16.png composited on each background; arc sample (7,5) vs glass (7,3), needle (9,8) vs glass (8,7), origin top-left. These are representative samples, not minimum contrast across all antialiased pixels.

fresh.usage: Optional small status indicator with a Fresh label and update time.

delayed.usage: Delayed data, paired with a timestamp.

stale_or_error.usage: Unavailable, stale or failed readings. Explain the specific condition in text.

over_budget.usage: A measured budget warning, paired with the amount over budget.

system_color_note: State hex values are fixed sRGB design references close to standard system colours. In a native app, prefer the named dynamic NSColor tokens so appearance and accessibility can adapt.

contrast.method: WCAG 2 relative luminance, sRGB linearization, opaque flat colours, rounded to two decimals
contrast.usage: Use light accent text on white and dark accent text on near-black. Light accent on paper is 4.47:1, suitable for the icon graphic but below 4.5:1 for normal text; use ink for small text on paper. Ratios do not cover glass gradients or semantic state colours.
